fields.title: Native-code performance, no abstraction tax
fields.statement: The framework must never be the bottleneck. Deliver ORM-level convenience at hand-optimized ADO.NET speed: compile property-to-data mapping into cached expression trees so reflection runs only once per model, favor stored procedures to cut parse/compile overhead and round-trips, and run shard queries concurrently across servers.
fields.rationale: Most ORMs trade performance for convenience; ArgentSea refuses that trade. Reflection on every data access is too slow, so the mapper pays it once and reuses compiled code at machine-code speed thereafter. The only cost is a sub-second first-call compilation (repaid on every subsequent call and reset only on restart) — an acceptable price for native speed and the reason ArgentSea suits even performance-critical, non-sharded applications.
